newsitem.title: USA: Basin plugs one well, to explore two others.
newsitem.headline: Basin plugs one well, to explore two others.

text.p: Basin Exploration Inc said Wednesday it plans to acquire an interest in a waterflood project that will increase its interest in the Jepson/Holler Draw unit from 1.6 percent to 26.6 percent.

The company also announced it had plugged and abandoned a well in the Gulf of Mexico, and plans to pursue the exploration of two Gulf wells once it places partial interests in the prospects with industry partners.
The company's share of the estimated project development costs is about $6 million, of which about $2 million is expected to be incurred this year.
The well that was abandoned was drilled on High Island Block 12-L, a state lease offshore in Texas in which Basin had acquired a 100 percent interest last April.
After selling interests to industry partners, Basin retained a 33.3 percent participation interest in the well.
The company's next two exploratory tests are now scheduled to be consecutively drilled on contiguous blocks offshore in Louisiana, at Eugene Island 64 and Eugene Island 65.
